title: SnO2 modified CsH2PO4 (CDP) protonic electrolyte for an electrochemical hydrogen pump
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4YA00606B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Minal Gupta, Kangkang Zhang, Kevin Huang
Hydrophilic SnO2 is introduced into CsH2PO4 (CDP) to mitigate CDP's dehydration at lower partial pressure of steam, thus retaining proton conductivity.
